title: Thorm's Bosses
description: An action-packed End expansion adding 3 new dimensions, custom resource progression, and 8 legendary animated bosses with exclusive rewards.
body:
# 🌌 Thorm's Bosses: The Ultimate End Expansion

Did you think defeating the Ender Dragon was the end of the journey? **Thorm's Bosses** completely transforms Minecraft's endgame by introducing a massive **End Update** packed with uncharted dimensions, strategic new resources, and colossal challenges. Travel far beyond the End void, discover alien materials, and face the ultimate cosmic guardians. --- ## 🚀 Key Features * 🌌 **3 New Post-End Dimensions:** Journey into three entirely brand-new realms, each featuring its own unique environment, world generation, and atmosphere. * 💎 **New Tier of Resource Progression:** Discover and mine a variety of exclusive new ores to craft endgame armor sets and highly powerful weapons. * ⚔️ **8 Legendary Boss Encounters:** Challenge eight distinct custom bosses, each guarding the deepest and most valuable secrets of the mod. * 🐍 **Unique Ecosystem:** Encounter dozens of custom entities, ranging from exotic snakes and mysterious slime variants to deadly hostile threats. --- ## 👁️ The Void Realms & End Mechanics The End and its surrounding dimensions have become far more hazardous. Watch your step around these new entities: ### 👾 Mimic Entities * **Mimic Cube:** A terrifyingly fast new slime variant. It mimics the battlefield's energy, dealing the exact same amount of damage as the last attack it received! * **Mimic Guard:** A tougher variant with increased health and damage. Every few seconds, it shoots a projectile that inflicts damage, knockback, and **Levitation**. * *Balanced Combat:* To prevent frustrating infinite levitation loops (unlike Shulkers), the Guard cannot aim its projectile upwards—it only fires along the X and Z axes. * **Giant Variants:** Both the Mimic Cube and Mimic Guard have colossal giant versions. Upon defeat, they split into 4 smaller, aggressive versions. The **Giant Mimic Guard** even features a complex, boss-like attack pattern! ### 💀 Miniboss: The Void Reaper A dark specter lurking in the void, wielding a massive **Enderite Scythe**. This miniboss features an intricate attack pattern worthy of a main boss encounter. * **The Ultimate Reward:** Defeating the Void Reaper drops an **Enderite Relic**. Use it to craft your own Scythe and unleash the exact same devastating abilities against your enemies! ## 💎 New Endgame Ores * 🟣 **Enderite:** The End's equivalent to Netherite. It represents the absolute pinnacle of vanilla tier gear and serves as the essential base material required to access the mod's new dimensions. * 🔮 **Void Crystal:** A beautiful amethyst-like block cluster. Stepping on or touching these crystals alters physics, reducing the player's gravity. * 🔶 **Amber:** A highly frequent and versatile resource found throughout the world, essential for crafting various utility items and blocks across the mod. --- ## 👹 Featured Bosses ### 🔫 Minigunner Thorm *(The First Threat)* Do not step into his arena unprepared! This heavy-weapon specialist forces you to stay on your feet. * **Abilities:** Fires a devastating barrage of 4 bullets per second and launches high-explosive bombs. * **Strategy:** Highly recommended to approach with ranged weapons and proper shielding. ### 💥 XXL Thorm *(The Colossus)* Massive but predictable, this giant relies on raw brute force and overwhelming numbers. * **Abilities:** Triggers self-explosions, deals heavy area damage, and continuously summons minions to distract you. * **Strategy:** Keep your distance and clear his minions quickly before attacking. ### 🔮 Evoker Thorm *(The Dark Mage)* A master of arcane magic who controls the battlefield from afar but crumbles under pressure. * **Abilities:** Summons fangs from the ground, casts homing magic orbs, calls for reinforcements, and regenerates health. * **Strategy:** Close the gap immediately! He is extremely vulnerable to aggressive melee combat. ### 🎋 Sculptor Thorm *(The Masterpiece - Dev's Favorite!)* The ultimate test of skill. A dynamic, multi-phase boss fight that utilizes the very environment against you. * **Abilities:** Telekinetically lifts and hurls giant rocks, strikes with a cursed bamboo staff, summons spikes from the earth, and unlocks an aggressive **Second Phase**. --- ## ⚙️ Compatibility & Requirements * **Minecraft Version:** 1.20.1 * **Supported Loaders:** Forge * **Requirements:** [Geckolib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib)
